title: Delhi Police Nabs Shahzad Bhatti’s Associates Vikas, Hargurpreet & Arif
description: Delhi Police Special Cell has uncovered a major Pakistan-backed terror module being run by gangster Shahzad Bhatti, who is believed to be operating under the command of Pakistan’s intelligence network. According to Additional CP Pramod Kumar Kushwaha, three suspects have been arrested — Hargunpreet Singh of Punjab, Vikas Prajapati of Madhya Pradesh, and Arif from Uttar Pradesh. The trio allegedly executed a hand grenade attack outside Gurdaspur City Police Station on the 25th and had conducted recce and videography of multiple high-risk targets across India. Bhatti allegedly recruited vulnerable youth through social media to fuel terror activities. More operatives linked to the module are under scrutiny, with coordinated action underway alongside Punjab Police.
